findings.title: Concurrent withdrawals can overdraw: read-check-write in a READ COMMITTED transaction
findings.explanation: The balance is read, checked and written back inside a default-isolation transaction; two concurrent withdrawals read the same balance and both pass the check.
findings.evidence: await tx.account.update({ where: { id: accountId }, data: { credits: account.credits - amount } });
findings.trigger: Two withdrawals of 60 from a balance of 100 at the same time
findings.violatedInvariant: Credits never go below zero and every withdrawal is debited
